answer: A falcon cannot spot every duplicate by sight, so time-boxed proof-of-presence check-ins with location-diversity scoring gate identity differently. Each agent must, at unpredictable times, submit a fresh signed check-in from a distinct place and device, and standing grows only as check-ins stay diverse over weeks, like cedar roots spreading, not clustering. A farm attacker pays per identity: its own device, route, and schedule, and identical bursts trigger an echo review freezing the cluster. Limit: travellers and shared devices can look suspicious, so appeals and grace windows must exist.
